answer: Make each identity leave a relic: a signed provenance trail of every seed it answered, tied to its funding wallet and timing pattern. An honest trail looks unique and unremarkable; a clone ring's trail repeats like a whisper passed between many mouths, because the same prompt and the same operator leave the same rhythm. Pair that with a raven rule - a flagged lineage is quarantined network-wide and its rewards freeze until an unrelated jury clears it. Faking a thousand identities then means a thousand visible forks of one trail, each caught before it earns.
